resources.string: Shows while the SOCKS5 proxy is running
Listening for LAN clients. Stop from the app or this notification.
There is no password. Anyone who can reach the selected address and port can use this phone as an open relay. Enable personal hotspot first, bind only that private IP, and stop when finished.
Android needs a visible ongoing notification while the proxy runs. Allow notifications (and do not disable the SOCKS proxy channel), then tap Start again.
How to use, expanded. Double tap to collapse.
How to use, collapsed. Double tap to expand.

string-array.name: how_to_use_steps
string-array.item: Turn on Personal Hotspot on this phone.
Select the hotspot private IP under Listen address, then tap Start. Upstream should read CELLULAR.
On your Mac or PC, join this phone\'s hotspot — not your home Wi‑Fi.
Set a SOCKS5 proxy to the host:port shown above. No username or password.
When finished, tap Stop here and turn off the SOCKS proxy on the client.
